name: Receipt Lineage and Merkle Linking
description: Receipts form a Merkle tree within each session and across sessions. Prove inclusion without revealing all data.
acceptanceCriteria: Receipts within a session form a Merkle tree structure.
Cross-session receipt linking produces a global Merkle DAG.
Merkle proofs can prove receipt inclusion without revealing the full tree.
Receipt verification accepts a proof and a trusted root hash.
Merkle root hashes are periodically anchored to an immutable store.
